tasks.title: ngv2 state machine: deterministic hunt phase machine over Finding
acceptance_criteria: NEW file ngv2/state_machine.py exists and imports Finding via 'from ngv2.contracts import Finding' (does NOT redefine Finding).

Module exposes ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS = {'hunt':('triage','done'),'triage':('poc','done'),'poc':('detonate','done'),'detonate':('report','done'),'report':('done',),'done':()} typed as dict[str, tuple[str,...]].
@dataclass HuntState(phase:str='hunt', findings:list=field(default_factory=list)) is defined with exactly those fields in that order.
HuntStateMachine.__init__(self, state: HuntState | None = None) sets self.state = state or HuntState().
can_transition(self, to) -> bool returns to in ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS.get(self.state.phase, ()).
transition(self, to) raises ValueError when not can_transition, else sets self.state.phase = to.
add_finding(self, finding) appends finding to self.state.findings.
to_dict(self) returns {'phase': self.state.phase, 'findings': [f.to_dict() for f in self.state.findings]}.
from_dict(cls, d) classmethod returns cls(HuntState(phase=d['phase'], findings=[Finding.from_dict(x) for x in d.get('findings', [])])).
No eval/exec/__import__, no I/O, no network, no globals, no randomness; stdlib only (dataclasses/typing) plus the ngv2.contracts import.
python -m pytest tests/test_state_machine.py -q passes against the committed oracle test.

spec.objective: Implement NEW file ngv2/state_machine.py as a deterministic, serializable hunt->triage->poc->detonate->report->done phase machine over Finding, using stdlib only, so the already-committed oracle tests/test_state_machine.py pass.
functional_requirements: Define @dataclass HuntState with phase: str = 'hunt' and findings: list = field(default_factory=list), in that field order.
Define class HuntStateMachine with __init__(self, state: HuntState | None = None) that sets self.state = state or HuntState().
Implement can_transition(self, to) -> bool returning to in ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS.get(self.state.phase, ()).
Implement transition(self, to) that raises ValueError if not self.can_transition(to), otherwise sets self.state.phase = to.
Implement add_finding(self, finding) that appends finding to self.state.findings.
Implement to_dict(self) returning {'phase': self.state.phase, 'findings': [f.to_dict() for f in self.state.findings]}.
Implement classmethod from_dict(cls, d) returning cls(HuntState(phase=d['phase'], findings=[Finding.from_dict(x) for x in d.get('findings', [])])).
Import Finding via 'from ngv2.contracts import Finding' and do not redefine the Finding dataclass.
spec.interfaces: from ngv2.contracts import Finding (Finding.from_dict(d) -> Finding, Finding.to_dict() -> dict keyed exactly by field names id,target,category,severity,title,description,evidence); PHASES = ('hunt','triage','poc','detonate','report','done'); ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS: dict[str, tuple[str,...]] = {'hunt':('triage','done'),'triage':('poc','done'),'poc':('detonate','done'),'detonate':('report','done'),'report':('done',),'done':()}; @dataclass HuntState(phase:str='hunt', findings:list=field(default_factory=list)); class HuntStateMachine: __init__(self, state: HuntState | None = None); can_transition(self, to) -> bool; transition(self, to); add_finding(self, finding); to_dict(self) -> dict; classmethod from_dict(cls, d).
edge_cases: transition to a non-allowed target (e.g. hunt->poc) must raise ValueError and leave self.state.phase unchanged.
transition from terminal 'done' phase must raise ValueError for any target since ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS['done'] == ().
can_transition must use ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS.get(phase, ()) so an unknown/unexpected phase returns False rather than raising KeyError.
from_dict with a dict missing the 'findings' key must default to an empty list via d.get('findings', []).
to_dict on a state with no findings must return {'phase': <phase>, 'findings': []}.
Round-trip from_dict(to_dict(...)) must preserve phase and reconstruct Finding objects via Finding.from_dict.
Each phase allows transition to 'done' (early-stop) in addition to its next phase.
non_goals: Do NOT author, create, or modify any test file; tests/test_state_machine.py is already committed.
Do NOT redefine the Finding contract dataclass; import it from ngv2.contracts.
Do NOT use eval, exec, or __import__.
Do NOT add fields, methods, or symbols beyond those specified, and do not change field names or order.
Do NOT add I/O, file access, network, globals, or randomness; stdlib only (dataclasses/typing plus the ngv2.contracts import).
Do NOT collapse modules or build the detonation chamber here.
spec.implementation_notes: Single new file ngv2/state_machine.py. Use 'from dataclasses import dataclass, field' and 'from ngv2.contracts import Finding'. Keep PHASES and ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS as exact module-level literals matching the brief; annotate ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS as dict[str, tuple[str,...]]. HuntState is a plain @dataclass; HuntStateMachine wraps it. Mutating methods (transition, add_finding) operate in place on self.state. to_dict/from_dict are the serialization boundary and must delegate to Finding.to_dict/Finding.from_dict for the findings list. Depends on sibling ngv2-artifact-contract providing ngv2.contracts.Finding.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: Finding instances built from ngv2.contracts.Finding with the canonical field set (id, target, category, severity, title, description, evidence); dict fixtures with and without the 'findings' key for from_dict; phase strings drawn from PHASES for transition coverage. Oracle tests/test_state_machine.py is the source of truth and is already committed.
